newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: PRESS DIGEST - Ireland, March 11.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Ireland, March 11.

text.p: The following are the highlights of stories from the Irish press on Tuesday.

- Tony O'Reilly is to step down as chief executive of the multinational Heinz corporation, once a major restructuring, to be announced later this week, is well advanced, sources said - Sterling falls as inflation fear eases
- Alliance of churches criticises proposals on right to run schools
- Hepatitis C report does not call for disciplinary action against any employee of the Blood Transfusion Service Board
- President Mugabe in fire alert on aircraft in Shannon airport - First National earning growth raised profit 17 percent to 28.2 million Irish pounds
- Government seeking EU derogation on VAT rules
- Ardagh chief issues warning over EMU
- Esat Digifone, which is to launch Ireland's second mobile phone facitliy on March 21, said it will reimburse the cost of lost calls
